_comment: Synthetic GitHub REST responses for the reads of the real-run preconditions (src/schedules/preconditions.py, #347), in the shape GitHub's REST reference gives for GET /repos/R/rules/branches/main, /actions/permissions/workflow and /actions/secrets. Written by hand, not recorded (#347 open question Q-fixtures): no call was made with real credentials, and the field names are recalled from the reference, not verified against a live answer. The state mirrors what docs/autodev-plan.md records for 2026-10-12 (a ruleset with deletion, non_fast_forward and one required approval; workflows that cannot approve; no repository secrets); the ruleset ID is made up. Used by tests/test_schedules_preconditions.py.
